numbering_note: A01–A60 are audit-derived criteria, not the unavailable original Q1–Q60 question identifiers.

requirements.title: Continuous autonomous research bounded by resources

requirements.title: Restricted web research, evidence and citations

requirements.title: Nine research/review/orchestrator agent roles

requirements.title: Isolated code branches and controlled release promotion

requirements.title: XGBoost, LightGBM, HMM/clustering comparisons

requirements.title: Time-available features and fold-local preprocessing

requirements.title: vectorbt screening

requirements.title: Event-driven backtest and executable signal parity

requirements.title: Bid/ask, spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial/rejected fills

requirements.title: Adaptive statistical/compliance gates for paper eligibility
requirements.next_gate: Implement family/instrument thresholds outside candidate-agent authority with auditable decisions.

requirements.title: Measured five-year coverage target and incomplete-data gates

requirements.title: MT5/broker and legitimate public/licensed historical ingestion
requirements.next_gate: Implement entitlement/provenance checks, resumable ingestion and separate actual-service tests.

requirements.title: Degradation auto-pause and manual live reactivation

requirements.title: Durable intent IDs, UNKNOWN state and retry idempotency

requirements.title: Broker capability matrix, safe OCO and reconnect reconciliation
